verdict.rationale: 2FAS's own docs say the app imports from several named authenticator apps (Aegis, Raivo, LastPass, Stratum/Authenticator Pro and Google Authenticator), so it directly supports migrating from other apps. The single support-page line does not describe the import mechanics, so bulk migration of many tokens at once is implied rather than documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation that imports transfer all tokens in bulk, details of the import workflow and file formats, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the imports work.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand

citations.quote: We support imports from Aegis, Raivo, LastPassAegis, Stratum (formerly Authenticator Pro) and Google Authenticator.
